question: Which of the following hand-operated drilling machines is used for drilling small diameter holes up to 6 mm?
solution:
The correct answer is __Bevel gear type drilling machine**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bevel gear type drilling machine__ is a commonly used hand-operated drilling machine.
 
• It is designed to drill small diameter holes up to 6 mm.
 
• This type of drilling machine uses bevel gears to transmit motion and torque efficiently.
 
• It is lightweight and suitable for manual operations.
 
• Its ergonomic design makes it easy to handle for precise drilling tasks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Breast drilling machine:**
 
 
• It is manually operated and used for larger holes compared to bevel gear type machines.
 
• It is equipped with a breastplate for applying pressure during drilling.
 
 
 
• **Electric hand drill:**
 
 
• It is powered by electricity and used for faster and effortless drilling.
 
• Typically used for larger drilling tasks and materials.
 
 
 
• **Ratchet drilling machine:**
 
 
• It is a manual tool used for slow and precise drilling in hard materials.
 
• Primarily employed in woodworking and metalworking.
